system.description:
You craft protective charms and runic wards. Crafting them requires a Spellcast Roll (15) as a Downtime action, which consumes 3 Handfuls and remains potent until destroyed.

  • Saltborne Fetish. A ritual circle, drawn in paint made from moss, bone, and salt. Horrors attempting to cross surfaces marked with this symbol must pass a Reaction Roll (15) or become temporarily Restrained.
  • Witch’s Hair. A charm of knotted blood-soaked thread from an evil witch. Prevents possession or mental intrusion by magic, spirits and Horrors - while holding it, the wearer may spend a Hope to automatically resist such attempts. Then, roll 1d8. If the result is 8, the charm becomes inert.
  • Saltstone Ward. A stone from a blessed river, infused with protective magic. The ward’s holder can spend a Hope to reduce incoming damage by 1d8. On an 8, it becomes inert.
